page_note: Page contains two structural movements. First half (segs 0-20) completes a "three grievers" teaching: the second griever is a cosmic father whose five sons stand in the danger (substrate), but the third griever is Mani himself, leading into a heavily ecclesial-autobiographical excursus about the holy Church and the lost souls — this is institutional editorial material in first-person voice. Second half (segs 21-33) opens new chapter 59 "The Elements that wept" with a substantive cosmological teaching about the four weepings of the sons of the First Man — clean substrate enumeration. Editorial fatigue score is negative because the institutional vocabulary clusters in segs 9-13 (the church-founding autobiography), then the page returns to substrate teaching after the chapter break. Seam flag at seg 24 ("Ⲧⲧⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲁⲛ") confirms the standard frame opener, but the content following is substrate cosmology.
